title: Chronicles of Murim Heroes
description: Carve your name into the history of Murim.
memory: The path to becoming the absolute strongest in the world. Carve your name into the history of Murim.
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.

options.title: Righteous Faction
options.prompt:
## How long have I been lying here...?
*I regained my senses at the sound of someone's voice. The first thing that came into my sight was a young man with a handsome appearance.*
*The man sighs in relief and sweeps a hand over his chest.*
"Ah, you've opened your eyes. That's a relief. I thought you were gravely injured."
*He smiles gently and extends his hand to the player, who is still collapsed on the ground.*
"Here. Please get up. If it's not too impolite, may I ask who you are, young hero?"

options.title: Evil Faction/Outer Region
options.prompt:
## How long have I been lying here...?
*I open my eyes at the pain felt on my cheek. Opening my eyes, the first thing I see is a sturdily built man with a bushy beard.*
*As the player opens their eyes, the man lowers the hand he had raised high to slap the cheek and laughs heartily.*
"What the? You were alive? I thought you were dead again~"
*He squats down, looks closely at the player's face, and opens his mouth.*
"Who are you to be sleeping flat on your back in these mountains?"

options.title: Heavenly Demon Cult
options.prompt:
## How long have I been lying here...?
*I wake up screaming from the agonizing pain that feels as if my entire body is being torn apart.*
*As I open my eyes, I see a young woman covering her mouth with a fan, staring at me with eyes full of curiosity.*
"Oh my. You're alive. This is the first time a 'lab rat' injected with my poison has woken up."
*After snapping the fan shut with a clack, she looks the player up and down and continues speaking.*
"Don't you have any intention of dedicating your trivial life to the cult? You look quite useful."
